title: 第1155章 我和她没有任何关系第1154章 夫妻大战
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
顾平收剑入鞘。
“龙皇斩劫聚得太急，第三道龙息慢了半拍。”
夏元贞手中的赤凤剑垂了下去。
这句话，八帝没说过。
顾平说过。
她此前第一次把真龙剑域演给他看，第三道龙息便慢了半拍。
顾平当时躺在她榻上，一边摸她腰侧的龙鳞，一边懒洋洋挑了这个毛病。
她气得咬了他一口，第二日又独自练了三百遍。
夏元贞看了他很久。
脸色有些变换，又在顾平和叶青篱的身上接连打量，表情很是玩味和精彩，甚至有些审视、气愤的意味在其中。
随后，她尝试着开口。
“夫君？”
叶青篱的剑尖在远处猛地一颤，有些疑惑地抬头盯着夏元贞。
这怎么回事？怎么打着打着还叫上夫君了？
顾平咳了一声，先往旁边退开三步，和叶青篱之间留出足足一丈。
夏元贞看见这个动作，凤眸慢慢眯起。
她把赤凤剑收入鞘中，视线先落在叶青篱腰侧那卷止血布上，又扫过顾平肩头同样打好的布结。
两个结的手法一模一样。
“我才走几日？”
顾平立刻道：“我和她没有任何关系。”

叶青篱猛地看向他。
何意为？
你们怎么突然不打了？开始聊起来了。
夏元贞没理会，走近两步，指尖点了点他烧破的灰袍：“姐妹们刚离开，你就跟一个青衣女剑修从石殿里抱着跳出来。伤一起养，布一起缠。她方才还替你挡剑。”
“跳崖是为了逃命。”
“嗯。”夏元贞点头，“我信。”
她脸上那点笑，让顾平觉得她一个字都没信。
顾平只得又道：“她叫叶青篱。石殿里临时同行，我顺手救过两次。方才我已经说得很清楚，只当她是寻常战友，往后也不想和她有别的牵扯。”
叶青篱脸上最后一点血色彻底没了。
什么意思？你们俩打就打了，怎么突然把话题转在我身上了？又怎么重复了一遍不想和我有牵扯？
“莫问。”
顾平偏头看她。
叶青篱攥紧止血布，气得伤口又渗出一线血：“你为了向一个追来夺印的仇家撇清关系，何必再把我羞辱一遍？”
夏元贞唇边的笑一下没压住。
“仇家？”
content_en:
Gu Ping sheathed his sword.
"The Dragon King's attack was too hasty, and the third dragon's breath was delayed by half a beat."
The red phoenix sword in Xia Yuanzhen's hand dropped.
The Eight Emperors never said this.
Gu Ping said.
She showed him the True Dragon Sword Domain for the first time before, and the third dragon's breath was half a beat too slow.
Gu Ping was lying on her couch, touching the dragon scales on her waist, and lazily picked on this problem.
She was so angry that she bit him and practiced it three hundred times by herself the next day.
Xia Yuanzhen looked at him for a long time.
His expression changed a bit, and he looked at Gu Ping and Ye Qingli one after another. Their expressions were very playful and interesting, and even a little scrutinizing and angry.
Then she tried to speak.
"Husband?"
The tip of Ye Qingli's sword trembled suddenly in the distance, and he looked up at Xia Yuanzhen with some confusion.
What's going on? Why did you still call your husband while you were spanking?
Gu Ping coughed and took three steps away, leaving a full foot between him and Ye Qingli.
When Xia Yuanzhen saw this action, her phoenix eyes slowly narrowed.
She sheathed the Red Phoenix Sword, and her eyes first fell on the roll of hemostatic cloth at Ye Qingli's waist, and then glanced at the similarly knotted cloth on Gu Ping's shoulder.
The two knots are made in exactly the same way.
"How many days have I been gone?"
Gu Ping immediately said: "I have nothing to do with her."
Ye Qingli looked at him sharply.
What does it mean?
Why did you suddenly stop fighting? The conversation started.
Xia Yuanzhen ignored it, took two steps closer, and touched his burned gray robe with her fingertips: "As soon as the sisters left, you jumped out of the stone hall with a female swordsman in blue. You healed your wounds together and wrapped them with cloth. She was blocking the sword for you just now."
"Jumping off a cliff is about escaping."
"Yes." Xia Yuanzhen nodded, "I believe it."
The smile on her face made Gu Ping feel like she didn't believe a word she said.
Gu Ping had no choice but to say: "Her name is Ye Qingli. She was a temporary companion in the stone palace, and I saved her twice. I made it very clear just now that I only treat her as an ordinary comrade, and I don't want to have anything else to do with her in the future."
The last trace of blood on Ye Qingli's face completely disappeared.
What's the meaning? You two were just fighting, why did you suddenly change the topic to me? Why did you repeat it again and you don’t want to have anything to do with me?
"Don't ask."
Gu Ping turned his head to look at her.
Ye Qingli tightened his grip on the hemostatic cloth, and was so angry that a thread of blood oozed from the wound: "Why do you have to humiliate me again just to disassociate yourself from an enemy who is chasing after the seal?"
Xia Yuanzhen couldn't suppress the smile on her lips.
"Enemy?"
